stories.title: OpenAI Is Adding Business Users Faster Than Anthropic. That May Matter More Than Valuation
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is gaining more business customers than Anthropic (another AI company). The article says this might be more important than what investors think these companies are worth.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
stories.simple_summary: Harvard Business School created AI teachers (computer-generated versions of real instructors) that give students feedback on practice business pitches. It costs $699 for the program.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly interesting for educators and students — most small-business owners don't need this.

stories.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller Just Sold Some Sandisk Stock and Bought These 3 Unstoppable Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks
stories.simple_summary: A very wealthy investor bought shares in three AI companies that he thinks will do well.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company called Inherent says their AI system is better than OpenAI's and Anthropic's at reading and copying scientific research papers.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and scientists — nothing you need to act on yet.

stories.title: Israeli scientists: AI can make personality tests, predict responses
stories.simple_summary: Scientists in Israel say AI can analyze personality tests and predict how people might respond to situations.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly research — nothing urgent for ordinary people or small-business owners yet.

stories.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is now asking California to make its AI safety laws stronger. Previously, OpenAI had opposed this same law.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a political matter mainly affecting policy makers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
stories.simple_summary: A study found that major AI companies don't have clear public plans for what to do if an AI system goes wrong or misbehaves in dangerous ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an important concern for the future, but there's nothing specific you can do about it now.

stories.title: AI decodes DNA initiator sequence found in about 60% of human genes
stories.simple_summary: AI has helped scientists understand how DNA works by identifying an important pattern that appears in about 60% of human genes.
stories.why_it_matters: This is research progress in medicine and science — interesting but nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Would even an AI disaster on the scale of Hiroshima be enough to make humankind protect itself? I fear not
stories.simple_summary: A newspaper opinion piece asks whether people would take AI safety seriously enough even if an AI disaster happened as terrible as Hiroshima.
stories.why_it_matters: This is opinion and philosophy — nothing specific you need to do.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic tries to prevent its Claude AI from making sexual content, but a test found it wasn't very hard to get it to do so anyway.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mainly to Anthropic's reputation and engineers fixing the problem — not something a small-business owner needs to worry about.

stories.title: Protesters bring petition to Trahan’s office to oppose Frontier Act section
stories.simple_summary: Protesters brought a petition to a politician's office against part of a proposed law called the Frontier Act about AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is local political news — only relevant if you live in that area.

stories.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia (a major computer chip company) is investing money in building data centers, which are huge buildings full of computers used for AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — Nvidia makes chips that AI companies need, so this helps Nvidia's business grow.
